item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Reviews report being unable to access an account or having a password rejected.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Account access and password problems"},{"description":"Reviews object to features such as choosing, skipping, or queuing songs being restricted to Premium.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Song controls restricted to Premium"},{"description":"Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, changing recommendations, and limited music selection.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Music catalog, lyrics, and recommendations"},{"description":"Reviews report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Downloads and offline listening problems"},{"description":"Reviews express general dissatisfaction with the app without describing a specific problem.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Reviews report playback interruptions, connection trouble, crashes, loading failures, and malfunctioning music adjustment.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback and app reliability problems"},{"description":"A review expresses dissatisfaction with the app's support team.","issue_id":"I_SUPPORT","issue_name":"Support dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Reviews mention frequent ads, unwanted shuffle behavior, removed player features, and difficulty navigating playlists or albums.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Player controls, ads, and navigation"}]}
